training_formula: grouped.agg(flow_count=("Timestamp", "size")) — number of CICFlowMeter flow rows whose Timestamp floors into the window
pcap_formula: g.agg(flow_count=("window_idx", "size")) — number of reconstructed flows whose FIRST packet falls in the window
notes: CICFlowMeter terminates flows on FIN/RST and a 120 s timeout; the PCAP path splits a 5-tuple only on a >120 s idle gap, so one CIC flow may map to a different number of reconstructed flows. Capture scope also differs (whole victim subnet vs the hosts actually captured).
inherits flow_count

training_formula: safe_log1p(sum over flows of (Tot Fwd Pkts + Tot Bwd Pkts))
pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(sum over flows of tot_pkts), tot_pkts = packets attributed to the reconstructed flow
notes: inherits the flow-segmentation and capture-scope difference

training_formula: safe_log1p(sum over flows of (TotLen Fwd Pkts + TotLen Bwd Pkts))
pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(sum over flows of total_bytes), total_bytes = sum of L4 payload lengths
notes: CICFlowMeter TotLen counts packet lengths as its engine defines them; the PCAP path sums L4 payload bytes. Same concept (bytes in window), different byte accounting.

training_formula: states['total_packets'] / WINDOW_SECONDS (window totals, not CIC per-flow rate fields)
notes: inherits total_packets
inherits total_bytes

training_formula: per flow: SYN Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); then mean over flows in the window. In the CIC CSVs the "* Flag Cnt" columns are BOOLEAN (0/1).
pcap_formula: per flow: int(any SYN in flow) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); then mean over flows
notes: Definition matches (binarised flag over flow packet count). Measured distributions still differ materially: the binarised definition is highly sensitive to flow length, and reconstructed flows are shorter than CICFlowMeter's.

training_formula: per flow: ACK Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: int(any ACK) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
notes: as syn_rate

training_formula: per flow: RST Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: int(any RST) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
notes: as syn_rate

training_formula: per flow: FIN Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: int(any FIN) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
notes: as syn_rate; measured divergence is largest here because flow-termination semantics differ

training_formula: per flow: PSH Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: int(any PSH) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
notes: as syn_rate

training_formula: per flow: URG Flag Cnt / (total_packets + 1e-8); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: int(any URG) / (tot_pkts + 1e-8); mean over flows
notes: as syn_rate

training_formula: mean over flows of the CIC per-flow column "Pkt Len Mean" (mean of a mean, not a pooled mean)
pcap_formula: mean over flows of pkt_len_mean, where pkt_len_mean = mean L4 payload length of the flow
notes: same mean-of-per-flow-mean structure; byte basis differs (CIC packet length vs L4 payload)

training_formula: mean over flows of the CIC per-flow column "Pkt Len Std" (mean of per-flow std, NOT a pooled std)
pcap_formula: mean over flows of pkt_len_std = sample std (ddof=1) of the flow's L4 payload lengths
notes: same structure; byte basis differs

training_formula: safe_log1p(mean over flows of "Flow Duration") — CICFlowMeter Flow Duration is in MICROSECONDS
pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(mean over flows of flow_duration_us) — (last-first packet time) * 1e6, MICROSECONDS
notes: units aligned (µs); the value differs because flow lifetimes differ between engines

training_formula: safe_log1p(mean over flows of "Fwd IAT Mean") — MICROSECONDS
pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(mean over flows of fwd_iat_mean_us) — mean diff of forward packet times * 1e6
notes: units aligned; residual divergence measured

training_formula: safe_log1p(mean over flows of "Bwd IAT Mean") — MICROSECONDS
notes: units aligned

training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(Tot Fwd Pkts, total_packets); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(tot_fwd_pkts, tot_pkts); mean over flows, forward = direction of the flow's FIRST packet
notes: identical formula and identical initiator-direction convention; values differ because flow segmentation differs

training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(Tot Bwd Pkts, total_packets); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(tot_bwd_pkts, tot_pkts); mean over flows
notes: as fwd_packet_ratio

training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(TotLen Fwd Pkts, total_bytes); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(totlen_fwd, total_bytes); mean over flows
notes: as fwd_packet_ratio

training_formula: per flow: safe_divide(TotLen Bwd Pkts, total_bytes); mean over flows
pcap_formula: per flow: _safe_divide(totlen_bwd, total_bytes); mean over flows
notes: as fwd_packet_ratio

training_formula: mean over flows of the CIC column "Down/Up Ratio" (integer-valued in the training CSVs)
pcap_formula: mean over flows of down_up_ratio = int(n_bwd // n_fwd), 0 when n_fwd == 0
notes: both integer-valued per flow; CIC's exact integer rule is not published

pcap_formula: _safe_log1p(nunique of dst_port over the flows in the window)
